submitted.rationale: Index 8 (In0.77Sb0.23) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0015%. It sits near the In11Sb3O24 composition, and its XRD shows a multi-peak pattern that best matches In11Sb3O24 and InSbO4 among the reference phases. The whole line is close to zero EQE under 2.4 eV light, which fits wide-gap In/Sb(V) oxides.

rejected.reason: EQE of -0.0005%. XRD shows a simple rutile-like pattern, matching no ternary phase well.
The In-rich end measured -0.0030% EQE despite the GP suggesting the region.
Not measured for EQE. XRD shows the same rutile-like single-phase pattern as index 21, so poor performance is likely.
